text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Finally, it is time for Mejiro Dober's<n>race against
Air Groove—a necessary<n>battle in her journey to
forge a new<n>Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober asks if I still believe in<n>her strength. I
tell her that my faith in<n>her has never changed since
the day<n>we met. With that, I see her off.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to look away. This is<n>the moment
Mejiro Dober will<n>transcend herself and forge a
new<n>Mejiro legacy!
